clue.text: Relating to written work, American cutting production of Tristan and Isolde

indicators.note: the abbreviation for American slices into the rearranged opera title
a new production of the opera reworks the letters of its title

explanation.surface: A remark about an American director slashing a staging of Wagner's Tristan and Isolde.
explanation.walkthrough: 'production of' rearranges TRISTAN ISOLDE into DISSERTTIONL with 'cutting' slipping A in; 'and' just joins the two names.
explanation.definitionFit: A dissertation is a long written thesis, so the adjective describes anything to do with such academic writing.

clue.text: Gloomy supporting party, Green politician: "Cuts can be broken down"

indicators.note: in a down clue a supporting piece sits underneath, so it comes after
the green politician pair slices into the party word

parts.note: a do is a party or celebration
eco- is the prefix for green, environmental
MP is a Member of Parliament
sable means black, dark and gloomy

explanation.surface: A downbeat party backs a Green MP's slogan that spending cuts can be dismantled.
explanation.definitionFit: Something decomposable can decay or be separated into simpler components, i.e. it is able to be broken down.

clue.text: Dry tears shed by one, half-heartedly?

indicators.note: the doubled central letter pair is cut to half, losing one of its two letters

parts.note: someone who sheds tears sobs, so is a sobber

explanation.surface: Someone weeping only half-heartedly while drying their tears.
explanation.definitionFit: Dry in the sense of teetotal or not drunk is a synonym of sober.

clue.text: Mathematician's set up hint — left concept on back of publication

indicators.note: in a down clue set up reads the word for hint from the bottom upward

parts.note: a cue is a prompt or hint
an idea is a concept

indicators.note: the back of a word is its final letter

explanation.surface: A mathematician's book idea, first jotted as a hint on the back of a publication.
explanation.definitionFit: Euclid was the Greek geometer, so the adjective formed from his name means belonging to that mathematician.

clue.text: Stirring Lohengrin tune — fight encompasses live masterpiece

indicators.note: the rearranged letters surround the word for live
stirring mixes the letters of the following words into a new order

parts.note: to be is to live or exist

explanation.surface: A rousing tune from Wagner's Lohengrin accompanies a fight scene in a great work.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Stirring' mixes LOHENGRIN TUNE FIGHT into THERINGOFTHENILUNG, which 'encompasses' BE. Wagner's four-opera Ring cycle is the masterpiece.
explanation.definitionFit: Wagner's vast four-opera cycle is widely regarded as his greatest work, an example of a masterpiece.

clue.text: Guided the unholy Tannhäuser on Rome expedition — devastated, primarily

indicators.note: primarily picks out the first letter of each word that precedes it

parts.words: the unholy Tannhäuser on Rome expedition — devastated

explanation.surface: Tannhäuser, the sinful knight in Wagner, makes a pilgrimage to Rome and leaves crushed.
explanation.walkthrough: In Wagner's opera Tannhäuser goes to Rome seeking forgiveness and returns in despair, which the surface recalls.
explanation.definitionFit: To tutor someone is to teach and direct them, so tutored is a synonym of guided.

clue.text: Adding change to Ring for female part

parts.note: a ring is round, the shape of the letter O
to vary is to change

explanation.surface: Altering Wagner's Ring cycle to suit a female role.
explanation.definitionFit: The ovary is the female reproductive organ, an example of a female body part.

clue.text: US equips air conditioning — cold son grabs remote

indicators.note: the two abbreviations hold the word for remote between them

parts.note: C stands for cold on taps
S is the genealogical abbreviation for son
outer means distant or remote

explanation.surface: Fitting out a house with air con, a chilly boy seizes the remote control.
explanation.definitionFit: Accouters is the American spelling of accoutres, meaning to kit out or equip with gear.

clue.text: Copper, British, in charge of the third degree

parts.note: Cu is the chemical symbol for copper

explanation.surface: A British police officer runs a harsh interrogation, giving someone the third degree.
explanation.definitionFit: Cubic relates to the third power in algebra, a polynomial whose highest degree is three.

clue.text: Passage to hypnotise

definitions.meaning: a way in or doorway through which one passes
to put someone into a trance, stressed on the second syllable

explanation.definitionFit: The same letters give a noun for a way in and a verb meaning to enchant or put into a trance.

clue.text: Cryptic setter's not getting love tablet: something for sex drive?

indicators.note: cryptic suggests a puzzling jumble, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: the setter is, giving the word with its S
love is nil in tennis, the letter O
E is slang for an ecstasy tablet

explanation.surface: A crossword setter refuses a tablet meant to boost sexual appetite.
explanation.definitionFit: This hormone governs libido, so it is a thing that fuels sex drive, a cryptic-style description.

clue.text: Drink, at home, one after Meistersinger's main character protects mastery

indicators.note: the outer letters shelter the word for mastery inside them
the home and one pieces follow the opera's initial
the main character of a word is its leading letter

parts.note: in means at home
I is the Roman numeral one
art is skill or mastery

explanation.surface: A drink at home after the central character of Wagner's Meistersinger shows off his mastery.
explanation.definitionFit: A martini is a cocktail of gin and vermouth, an example of a drink.

clue.text: See 23

anti means against
no is a denial

explanation.definitionFit: Quentin Tarantino is a famous American film director, an example of the definition.

clue.text: Sponsor of baptism, head and priest are not capturing day

indicators.note: the pieces enclose the abbreviation for day

parts.note: to head somewhere is to go there
aren't is the contraction of are not

explanation.surface: A church head and priest refuse to take in a day for a christening.
explanation.definitionFit: At a christening a godparent stands as sponsor, promising to guide the child's faith.

clue.text: U-turn on side

parts.note: about can mean on, as in a book on a subject
a face is a side of a solid

explanation.surface: A reversal of direction on one side of the road.
explanation.definitionFit: An about-face is a complete reversal of position or opinion, a figurative synonym for a U-turn.

clue.text: Plant short arrow over on Strongbow's left during advert

indicators.note: the piece goes into the middle of the word for advert

parts.note: ad is short for advertisement

indicators.note: the shortened arrow word spreads over the following pieces, enclosing them
short cuts off the final letter

parts.note: the word arrow as written

indicators.note: in an across clue the left of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: Strongbow, the Norman knight, fires short arrows during a commercial break.
explanation.walkthrough: 'over' here means wrapped around, not a reversal; Strongbow, the Norman knight, is surface colour and only gives his initial.
explanation.definitionFit: Aaron's rod is a name for the great mullein and other tall flowering species, so it is a plant.

clue.text: Delight of artist with start of Parsifal — prelude not over

parts.note: RA is a Royal Academician, a crossword artist

indicators.note: the start of a word is its initial letter
not removes the word over from the prelude

parts.note: an overture is an orchestral prelude
the word over taken as written

explanation.surface: An artist delighted by the opening of Parsifal, its prelude still going.
explanation.definitionFit: Rapture is intense joy or ecstasy, a stronger synonym of delight.

clue.text: Figure caught in The Flying Dutchman — doomed Senta (soprano) ultimately going off

indicators.note: the cricket abbreviation goes inside the jumbled final letters
going off suggests something spoiling and scattering, so the letters are rearranged
ultimately takes the last letter of each word listed

parts.note: C is the cricket abbreviation for caught

explanation.surface: In Wagner's Flying Dutchman the doomed heroine Senta, a soprano, finally hurls herself off a cliff.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ultimately' takes EGNDAO from the word ends, 'going off' rearranges them to DEAGON, and 'in' sets C inside. Senta leaps to her death at the opera's end.
explanation.definitionFit: A decagon is a ten-sided shape, an example of a figure in geometry.

clue.text: Unseats ordinary American, way back

parts.note: US means American

indicators.note: back means the abbreviation for way is read backwards

parts.note: St is an abbreviation for street, a way

explanation.surface: An ordinary American taking the road back ousts someone from their seat.
explanation.definitionFit: To oust a person is to remove them from office or position, so it is a synonym of unseat.

clue.text: In file, part of script to Pixar film (director's cut)

explanation.definitionFit: Lined up means arranged in a row or queue, which is what standing in file means.

clue.text: Daughter to pass water bottle's top for Yankee nerd

parts.note: to wee is to urinate

indicators.note: in a down clue the top of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: A daughter needs a toilet and grabs the cap of a bottle, the action of a geek.
explanation.definitionFit: Dweeb is American slang for a boring, socially inept person, a US synonym of nerd.

clue.text: Part from old TV broadcast of Bayreuth act incorporating poem

indicators.note: the rearranged letters take in the word for poem
a broadcast scatters, so these letters are rearranged

parts.note: an ode is a lyric poem

explanation.surface: A TV broadcast of an act from Wagner's Bayreuth festival includes a poem.
explanation.walkthrough: Bayreuth is the German town whose festival stages Wagner's operas. 'broadcast of' rearranges BAYREUTH ACT and 'incorporating' takes in ODE.
explanation.definitionFit: Old television sets used this vacuum tube to form the picture, so it is a component of them.

clue.text: Had one drawn with parts

indicators.note: the abbreviation for with splits the other pieces apart

parts.note: the word one taken as written
D stands for drawn in sports results

explanation.surface: Someone had a drawing made with separate parts.
explanation.definitionFit: To have owned something means to have possessed it, a synonym of had.

clue.text: See 4
In the morning, Number 10's Labour surgery?

parts.note: a.m. means in the morning
10 written as the letters I and O

explanation.surface: A morning bulletin on the Labour Prime Minister's operation at Number 10 Downing Street.
explanation.walkthrough: Number 10 Downing Street is the British Prime Minister's residence, and Labour is a UK party, but here labour is childbirth.
explanation.definitionFit: An amnio, short for amniocentesis, is a prenatal test procedure carried out before a baby is delivered.

clue.text: Initially, dead rude: Ben Elton cracks English line about sex?

indicators.note: initially takes the first letter of the next word
cracks breaks up the letters to be rearranged

explanation.surface: Comedian Ben Elton tells a crude English gag about sex.
explanation.walkthrough: Ben Elton is a British comedian known for his stand-up; 'cracks' suggests cracking jokes.
explanation.definitionFit: A double entendre is a phrase with a second, usually risqué, meaning, often a sexual innuendo.
